desc.zh: 从三个位置组合推导子序列计数与倒序动态规划。
desc.en: Derive subsequence counting and reverse DP from three choices of positions.

complexity: O(mn) arithmetic operations; O(n) integer cells

concepts.name: Subsequence counting
concepts.description: Partition index selections into skipping or using the last source position.

concepts.name: Reverse rolling DP
concepts.description: Keep the previous source-prefix row available during in-place updates.
